customSections.content: KCS prints 180 instructional days, but the footnote defines that total as 177 student instructional days plus three days accumulated under the daily seven-hour schedule. It should not be read as 180 full-length student attendance days.

customSections.label: KCS Weather and Makeup-Day Rule
customSections.content: The calendar says KCS may cancel up to eight instructional days because of inclement weather or serious outbreaks of illness before makeup days are required. For a closure, delay or early release, the district says it posts alerts on KCS websites, uses its notification system and contacts regional news media.

calendarFaqs.q: Was the first day of Knox County Schools a half-day in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Thursday, August 7, 2025, was the first student day and a districtwide half-day. Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation was held August 5 before the full student calendar began.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student half-days were on the KCS 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar listed seven student half-day dates: August 7, September 17, November 19, December 19, January 28, March 25 and May 21. Exact dismissal times came from the assigned school.

calendarFaqs.q: When did students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students returned Monday, January 5, 2026. Winter Break ran through January 2, and January 2 also carried half-day in-service and half-day administrative labels for staff.

calendarFaqs.q: Did KCS have 180 full student days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district defined its 180 instructional-day total as 177 student instructional days plus three days accumulated under the daily seven-hour schedule. Several student days were also scheduled as half-days.

calendarFaqs.q: How many cancellation days were built into the KCS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar allowed up to eight instructional cancellations for inclement weather or serious illness outbreaks before makeup days were required. Current district announcements controlled any actual schedule change.
